sql_query.query: SELECT cr.*, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM _care_task ct WHERE ct.careRecipientId = cr.id AND ct.status != 'COMPLETED') as pendingTasksCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM _medication m WHERE m.careRecipientId = cr.id AND m.active = true) as activeMedicationsCount FROM _care_recipient cr WHERE cr.primaryCaregiverId = $1 AND cr.status != 'INACTIVE' ORDER BY cr.createdAt DESC
